rows.summary: Top-level questPoints semantics DIVERGE. Browser: fed by first-goal completion (+1, cap QUEST_POINT_CAP=23) and restored from saves, so it persists; commissions do NOT feed it (client pane falls back to quests.questPoints for display only). Native: live counter resets to 0 on every login, but is incremented by BOTH commissions (cap 23) and first goal (cap min(+1,12)). Two unsynced counter pairs feed the same budget formula.
browserEvidence: server/core/first-goal.js:104 player.questPoints = min(23, qp+1); refreshTreeBudget resolves with player.questPoints
server/core/passives/verdigris-authority.js consumed with player.questPoints at socket-events/index.js:622 and player.js:114
nativeEvidence: native/src/networking.cpp:1597 first goal adds min(+1,12) cap 12
native/src/networking.cpp:815,1126 top-level state.questPoints and earned formula use tree_quest_points_
tests: playtest/scenarios/session-arc.mjs:158 goal reward grants exactly one Verdigris point
rows.gap: Which counter(s) may feed earned budget across relogins is not frozen by any spec; native and browser disagree on increment sources, caps (12 vs 23), and reset rules. Needs an architect/owner ruling; scaffold must expose counters explicitly instead of guessing.

rows.summary: Allocation is a client-computed, server-validated save envelope: player:skilltree:save {snapshot}. No chat command exists; the pane commits nodes/conduits locally then persists on every change and on close.
browserEvidence: server/player/handlers/socket-events/index.js:615-643 sanitisePassiveTree + resolveVerdigrisTree; reject reasons sent as game:send:message
nativeEvidence: native/src/networking.cpp:1157-1166 handle_skilltree_save stores payload verbatim, replies player:skilltree:update

rows.summary: Browser server REBUILDS and validates the allocation against the canonical graph (schemaVersion, origin required, unknown ids rejected, duplicate/malformed conduits rejected, conduit joins allocated nodes, spend <= earned, reachability from origin, locked subtree visibility, class order). Native ACCEPTS THE RAW SNAPSHOT UNVALIDATED: no schemaVersion check, no budget check, no adjacency check. A client can store an arbitrary overspent/disconnected tree natively; only the +2 attr walk and earned-spent arithmetic read it back.
browserEvidence: server/core/passives/verdigris-authority.js:28-111 resolveVerdigrisTree (comment line 24: 'snapshots are no longer trusted save blobs')
server/core/passives/verdigris-authority.js:113-128 resetVerdigrisTree / legacy pre-schemaVersion snapshots receive a one-time full refund
nativeEvidence: native/src/networking.cpp:1120-1155 passive_tree_json recomputes earned/spent arithmetically only

rows.summary: Node ids are axial hex coordinates 'q,r'. Axis directions after the WIZARD rotation: INT {q:1,r:0}, STR {q:-1,r:1}, DEX {q:0,r:-1}; pixel projection x=r*sqrt(3)/2*RADIUS, y=-(q+r/2)*RADIUS. Native's alignment scores (-q+r, -r, q) reproduce these axes correctly; only the MAGNITUDE (+2) is the approximation (see AT-2).
nativeEvidence: native/src/networking.cpp:1092-1112 axis scoring comment and str/dex/int scores
tests: playtest/scenarios/build-divergence.mjs allocateNodeToward walks 'q,r' ids along an axis

rows.summary: The '271-node' figure is stale prose from the nine-ring era. The generated canonical graph today is 331 main-lattice nodes (origin + 6*(1+..+10)) + 34 subtree nodes behind six gateway annexes = 365 nodes, 974 conduits, verified by executing the engine. vision.md still says nine-ring 271 nodes + 123-point economy (100 levels) while the shipped constants are ten-ring 331+34 and 140/117/23. No owner ruling freezes which document is authoritative; content itself remains owner-only.
browserEvidence: EXECUTED CHECK (this audit): main lattice nodes: 331; subtree nodes: 34; total: 365; conduits: 974; schemaVersion: 2
nativeEvidence: native/src/networking.cpp:818-821 stub note repeats the 271 figure
rows.gap: Docs/comment drift is unruled; OI-004 requires a versioned machine-readable graph so prose counts stop being load-bearing.

rows.summary: Browser: skilltree snapshots persist via guest-save-store, account SQLite (scion/token), and chronicles profile; quests (chain record incl. questPoints) persist alongside; pre-schemaVersion-2 trees get a one-time refund; commission chain resets only on scion admission; permadeath survives reconnect. Native mirrors session semantics in-memory per login: login resets the LIVE counter and transient state but keeps chain record/tree/xp; scion admission resets the whole chain; permadead lifecycle blocks resurrection.

Progression surfaces: login block player.passiveTree + player.quests; dev:state snapshot adds top-level questPoints, passiveTree (schemaVersion/nodes/conduits/points.skill/earned/selectedNodeId/classOrder), attributes {strength,dexterity,intelligence}, quests{firstGoal,activeQuestId,objectiveIndex,questPoints,completed}; quest:update pushes quests+questPoints+passiveTree; player:skilltree:update echoes the resolved tree after save.
